content.title: RBC Heritage 2026: Final round tee times, pairings and how to watch - Golf Channel
content.text: By Marisa Marcellino Published April 18, 2026 07:45 PM 0 seconds of 12 minutes, 58 secondsVolume 0% Matt Fitzpatrick leads by three strokes going into Sunday’s final round at the RBC Heritage and he’s in hot pursuit of his second victory on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina.Fitzpatrick won in 2023 in a thrilling playoff over Jordan Spieth. However, 2024 RBC Heritage champion Scottie Scheffler is doing everything in his power to make sure the current leader doesn’t secure another win at Harbour Town. The world No. 1 shot 7-under 64 on Saturday to put himself within striking distance of Fitzpatrick.
